onboarding.tour.targetMissing: We could not highlight this spot on screen. You can still use Next to continue—or open the menu on your phone if a link is hidden.
onboarding.tour.step0Body: Here you see your welcome summary, tier when active, contributions, claims used, and how much benefit you still have. This is the pulse of your cover.
onboarding.tour.step1Body: Open My Package to subscribe, pay monthly, upgrade for more dependants and benefits, or renew before cover lapses.
onboarding.tour.step2Body: After treatment, clinic staff raise the claim from their clinic dashboard. You use Claims here to track status and history—ask reception if something is missing.
onboarding.tour.step3Body: Visits is your treatment timeline: past appointments, clinics, procedures, and status—useful context before or after claims.
onboarding.tour.step4Body: Share your referral code from this area. Championship-style rewards grow as people you refer join and stay engaged.
onboarding.tour.step5Body: Browse partner clinics, camps, and the map so you know where to go for care that works with MenoDAO. Use Book to pick a time and share intake with the dentist.
onboarding.tour.step6Body: Your booked visits live here. Cancel or reschedule with a reason—the clinic is notified—and you get one reminder the day before and one an hour before.
onboarding.tour.step7Body: Review your contributions and treatment payments in one place—every payment made through MenoDAO mobile money is listed here.
onboarding.tour.step8Body: Update your personal details and preferred language—all in one place.

whyMenodao.title: Why Kenyans Choose MenoDAO
whyMenodao.subtitle: We're changing how dental care works in Kenya. No more waiting until you're in pain to see a dentist.
whyMenodao.card1Desc: Instead of paying KES 30,000 when you're in pain, you pay a little every month - like buying airtime. When you need care, it's already covered.
whyMenodao.card2Desc: Regular checkups mean we find small problems before they become big, expensive ones. You'll never lose a tooth unnecessarily.
whyMenodao.card3Desc: This isn't a big insurance company. It's a cooperative owned by members like you. You have a say in how things work.
